description: Extracts structured Tony Awards data from www.tonyawards.com including winners, nominees with winner status, press releases, and nominating committee members.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - winners: 获取获奖者列表; 可选参数: year, category; 参数: year, category; 必填: 无
  - nominees: 获取提名者列表(含获奖标记); 可选参数: year, category; 参数: year, category; 必填: 无
  - press_releases: 获取新闻稿列表; 参数: 无; 必填: 无
  - press_release: 获取单篇新闻稿详情; 需要参数: url; 参数: url; 必填: 无

year.description: 年份筛选 (如 "2026"); 用于 winners 和 nominees 功能

category.description: 类别筛选关键词 (如 "Best Play", "Actor"); 用于 winners 和 nominees 功能

url.description: 新闻稿URL (相对或绝对路径); 用于 press_release 功能
